text.description_html:
Laurey 38466, Ribbon Cabinet Knob in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Ribbon Cabinet Knob satisfies the want for simple cabinet hardware that still has character. These pretty Ribbon Cabinet Knobs will add a customer look to any lightweight door or drawer. The Laurey 38466 Ribbon Cabinet Knob in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with versatile mounting hardware to be sure you can easily install in in almost any application--be it in the kitchen, the bathroom vanity, or as a furniture drawer pull.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Ribbon Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38466 Oil Rubbed Bronze Ribbon Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Oil Rubbed Bronze Satin Nickel Stonewashed Bronze

Sold Individually
